scenario: [LGRA.5.9.5] — tolerance is logical-only. On an `explicit` (non-logical, non-ttl) schema a tolerance slot is rejected with the general DS_VALIDATE_TOLERANCE_NON_LOGICAL code (the ttl case keeps its own TTL_SCHEMA code). Non-logical facts carry no identity and do not dedup, so tolerance has no effect; the runtime rejects tolerance on any non-logical slot too.
